crew.overview: Bill O'Neal infiltrates the Black Panthers on the orders of FBI Agent Mitchell and J. Edgar Hoover. As Black Panther Chairman Fred Hampton ascends—falling for a fellow revolutionary en route—a battle wages for O’Neal’s soul.
crew.title: Judas and the Black Messiah

crew.overview: Two teens facing personal struggles form a powerful bond as they embark on a cathartic journey chronicling the wonders of Indiana.
crew.title: All the Bright Places

details.biography:
Jeffrey Lange is a multi-talented crew member based out of Cleveland, Ohio. He works primarily in the property and set decoration departments on major motion pictures, but also directs, writes, produces, and acts in local comedy productions. His past experiences additionally include positions in the sound and casting departments.

Jeffrey's passion for slapdash, DIY filmmaking in his early twenties provided him with a crash-course in all aspects of basic production. Joining IATSE and stepping onto big-budget sets allowed him the opportunity to take those skills to the next level of professionalism.
details.name: Jeffrey Lange
